protocol.fixtures: 12 task worlds at small and 200-record candidate sizes; 24 per phase
protocol.phase_order: raw/dom in even rounds, dom/raw in odd rounds
protocol.timing: Client perf_counter from JSON serialization to complete response JSON decoding

protocol.startup: one fresh service process per device, includes Python import/model load until health ready; OS file cache not cleared
protocol.scope: Measured local service path; no hosted network, TLS, reverse proxy, WAN, sustained soak or production SLO claim
